title: SYSK’s Scare Your Pants Off (and Back On) Halloween Spooktacular
summary: Annual Halloween episode of Stuff You Should Know. Hosts Josh and Chuck read two public-domain horror stories aloud in character. First, Philip K. Dick's "Beyond the Door," about Doris, her husband Larry, a cuckoo clock, and the cuckoo that kills Larry with a blow after he threatens it with a hammer. Then M. R. James's "Rats" (presented as "Rats" by m R James), about Mr. Thompson, who stays at an inn in Suffolk and discovers a dead, shrouded figure of a former landlord chained in a locked room. The hosts comment on the stories between readings, discuss the public domain status of Dick's work, mention a book preorder and an ad-free episode, and wish listeners a happy Halloween.

segments.title: Opening banter and Halloween tradition
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck open with jokes about scaring the pants off listeners, note that Philip K. Dick's work recently entered the public domain, and set up the annual Halloween reading.

segments.title: Reading: Beyond the Door by Philip K. Dick
segments.summary: Chuck reads Dick's story of Larry Thomas, who buys his wife Doris a cuckoo clock. The cuckoo comes out to Doris but resents Larry. Doris has an affair with Bob Chambers, Larry catches them, and Larry threatens the cuckoo with a hammer. The cuckoo strikes him and he falls and dies. The hosts discuss the plot and what it means.

segments.title: Transition to second story
segments.summary: The hosts discuss the first story's ending and introduce Chuck's pick, M. R. James's Rats.

segments.title: Reading: Rats by M. R. James
segments.summary: Josh reads M. R. James's story about Mr. Thompson, a Cambridge student who stays at an inn in Suffolk. He finds a shrouded figure in a locked room, learns from the innkeepers that a hanged former landlord is kept there, and leaves. The hosts comment on the accents and the story's details.

segments.title: Discussion and where to find the stories
segments.summary: The hosts recap the second story, note that both stories are online and in the public domain, and mention readings on YouTube.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck wish listeners a safe and happy Halloween.
